answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 11331 Country: India Title: Respected grand mufti assalamaliakum plz provide me the detail ruling of tabbco n cigarratte in islam. Question: Respected grand mufti assalamaliakum plz provide me the detail ruling of tabbco n cigarratte in islam. Answer ID: 11331 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 770/539=H/1430) The tobacco and cigarette harmful for health are unlawful to consume. But, if it is not causing any harm, then using it unnecessarily is merely makrooh, and if needed then allowed but one should pay attention to remove the bad smell. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
